args.title: Juniper Labware — Freight pricing this quarter (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest issue, "Freight pricing this quarter," links to the full article at blog.juniper.example/2026/freight and notes a subscribers-only companion piece.
- Article (Freight pricing this quarter): spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (subscriber access via team code SUB-7378): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
